assessment.frontState: Suwon-Osan pressure / Wonju contested / east coast withdrawal
assessment.summary: The North Korean advance retains the initiative across all three principal corridors. The western thrust has broken the morning Suwon delay and is pressing toward Osan. The central advance is approaching Wonju against a more coherent ROK 6th Division withdrawal. East-coast forces are separated by difficult terrain and incomplete reporting.
assessment.commanderNote: The displayed line is an intelligence estimate, not a continuous trench system. Local columns, bypassed defenders, refugees, and friendly withdrawals may exist on either side of it.

sectors.name: Western Corridor
sectors.note: NKPA 4th Division spearheads are advancing on Suwon with tanks. ROK traffic and headquarters elements are withdrawing south through Osan.

sectors.name: Central Mountains
sectors.note: The former NKPA 7th Division, redesignated 12th, is behind schedule but approaching Wonju. ROK 6th Division remains the most coherent major defending formation in the sector.

sectors.name: East Coast
sectors.note: NKPA 5th Division and attached irregular forces are moving south and inland. ROK 8th Division reports are delayed by terrain and disrupted communications.

squadron.name: 81st Fighter-Bomber Squadron, Black Scorpions
squadron.note: All four aircraft and pilots returned from Sortie 001. Individual post-flight aircraft condition was not reported; the serviceable count remains a planning estimate.

sorties.name: Suwon Road Interdiction

sorties.name: Osan Road Hunt
sorties.effect: Armed reconnaissance tasked to reacquire and delay the moving column
